type:
∀ {τ : Type u_1} {U : MvPolynomial τ ℤ} {V' : Polynomial ℚ} {F : MvPolynomial (Option τ) ℤ},
  U.support.gcd ⇑U.coeff = 1 →
    (map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) F = (rename some) ((map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) U) * (Polynomial.aeval (X none)) V' →
      ∃ (V : Polynomial ℤ), Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) V = V'
what: When an integer multivariate polynomial is a separated product of an integer factor with coefficient gcd one and a rational univariate factor, the univariate factor has integer coefficients.
how: Extract every product coefficient with coeff_rename_mul_aeval and use exists_int_eq_of_gcd_eq_one; Polynomial.mem_map_range assembles the integral factor.
hypotheses: Primitive integral ordinary-variable factor and integral separated product. The exact captured parameters and existing ambient types are printed; no additional project-defined structure is captured.
caller_summary: 1 explicit source caller declarations, all in Separation.lean; 1 direct original value consumers. Exact separate lists retained. Entire Separation module proof bodies replay successfully with fresh target name.
mathlib_api_audit: For each univariate coefficient, coeff_rename_mul_aeval identifies its products with the primitive factor coefficients as integer coefficients of the given product. exists_int_eq_of_gcd_eq_one then gives an integer witness for each coefficient, and Polynomial.mem_map_range assembles the integer polynomial. This coefficient descent is distinct from scalar compensation and from choosing a primitive representative.
moral_duplications: The helper has a distinct role in the separated polynomial proof as described in the structural review; no duplicate full construction is introduced.
